title: AP gl services
summary: Ledgerline AP general ledger journal voucher services gl_post, gl_query, and gl_reverse for screen AP-GL-14.
body:
The `services-ap-gl` service group provides journal voucher processing for the Accounts Payable module on screen [[screen-ap-gl-14|AP-GL-14]] [^r8][^r12]. Available since Ledgerline 7.0, it contains the three services `gl_post`, `gl_query`, and `gl_reverse` to post, inspect, and reverse general ledger journal vouchers [^r8][^r12][^r18][^r23]. All requests authenticate via session tokens passed in the `X-LL-Session` header and require corresponding user role authorizations [^r13][^r19][^r24].

## Services

### gl_post

The `gl_post` service is an AP write service that provides GL POSTING POST functionality on screen [[screen-ap-gl-14|AP-GL-14]] [^r9][^r12]. It validates nominal accounts, period controls, and fields, closes the entry against editing, assigns references, and commits balances to the nominal ledger [^r2][^r4]. It executes backend procedure `sp_gl_post` at endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/gl_post` [^r13][^r15].

* **Required fields:** `jv_no` (string, JV NO) [^r9][^r14].
* **Optional fields:** `comment` (string, COMMENT) [^r14].
* **Errors:** [[err-gl-0001|ERR-GL-0001]] (GL POSTING NOT FOUND), [[err-gl-0007|ERR-GL-0007]] (GL POSTING NOT IN DRAFT (<status>)), ERR-SEC-0001 (ACCESS DENIED), ERR-SYS-0421 (<FIELD> MANDATORY), ERR-SYS-0422 (UNKNOWN FIELD <FIELD> / BAD VALUE FOR <FIELD>), and ERR-SYS-0503 (SERVER BUSY, TRY LATER) [^r4][^r7][^r16][^r17].
* **Source file:** `04_service_definitions/accounts_payable/gl_post.yaml` [^r12].

### gl_query

The `gl_query` service is an AP read service that retrieves committed general ledger journal voucher details into screen [[screen-ap-gl-14|AP-GL-14]] at endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/gl_query` [^r1][^r6][^r10][^r18]. It returns a standard response envelope containing `rc`, `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` [^r21].

* **Required fields:** none [^r10][^r20].
* **Optional fields:** `jv_dt` (date, JV DT), `acct_cd` (string, ACCOUNT), and `amount` (float, AMOUNT) [^r10][^r20].
* **Errors:** [[err-gl-0001|ERR-GL-0001]] (GL POSTING NOT FOUND), ERR-SEC-0001 (ACCESS DENIED), ERR-SYS-0421 (<FIELD> MANDATORY), ERR-SYS-0422 (UNKNOWN FIELD <FIELD> / BAD VALUE FOR <FIELD>), and ERR-SYS-0503 (SERVER BUSY, TRY LATER) [^r22].
* **Source file:** `04_service_definitions/accounts_payable/gl_query.yaml` [^r18].

### gl_reverse

The `gl_reverse` service is an AP write service providing GL POSTING REVERSE operations on screen [[screen-ap-gl-14|AP-GL-14]] at endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/gl_reverse` [^r11][^r23]. After prompting for a posting date and corrective explanation, it executes database procedure `sp_gl_reverse` to create an offsetting journal entry in the nominal ledger and link the original posting to the generated reversal voucher [^r3][^r5][^r11][^r27]. Its response envelope contains `rc`, `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` [^r26].

* **Required fields:** `jv_no` (string, JV NO) [^r11][^r25].
* **Optional fields:** `reason` (string, REASON) [^r11][^r25].
* **Errors:** [[err-gl-0001|ERR-GL-0001]] (GL POSTING NOT FOUND) [^r27].
* **Source file:** `04_service_definitions/accounts_payable/gl_reverse.yaml` [^r23].

## See also

* [[services-ap-inv|AP inv services]]
* [[services-ap-per|AP per services]]

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: GL POSTING QUERY (gl_query): Retrieves existing journal voucher records from the ledger based on criteria entered into the header fields.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: GL POSTING POST (gl_post): Validates all entered data across the fields, closes the entry against editing, assigns references, and commits the balances to the nominal ledger.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: The system processes the reversal through the background service, generates a balancing entry in the general ledger, and displays the confirmation.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: The system validates the nominal accounts and checks period controls. If successful, the screen clears and displays the generated reference in the JV NO field.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: select the gl_reverse (GL POSTING REVERSE) button. Enter the current posting date and the corrective explanation when prompted. The system generates an offsetting voucher and marks the original posting accordingly.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: enter the voucher reference into the JV NO field, and select the gl_query (GL POSTING QUERY) button. The screen populates the JV DT, COMMENT, and line details.

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r7.quote: ERR-GL-0007 GL POSTING NOT IN DRAFT (<status>) Cause: the action needs the document in Draft (or pending) and it is in another status

r8.quote: Post F9 gl_post Query gl_query Reverse gl_reverse Rule or message Code Gl Posting Not Found ERR-GL-0001

r9.quote: gl_post GL POSTING POST Kind: write. Screen: AP-GL-14. Since: 7.0. Procedures: sp_gl_post.

r10.quote: gl_query GL POSTING QUERY Kind: read. Screen: AP-GL-14. Since: 7.0. Procedures: none.

r11.quote: gl_reverse GL POSTING REVERSE Kind: write. Screen: AP-GL-14. Since: 7.0. Procedures: sp_gl_reverse.

r12.quote:
service: gl_post
title: GL POSTING POST
module: AP
kind: write
screen: AP-GL-14
since: "7.0"

r13.quote:
endpoint: POST /ll72/svc/gl_post
auth: session token in header X-LL-Session; the user's role must allow the service

r14.quote:
- {name: jv_no, type: str, required: true, desc: JV NO}
  - {name: comment, type: str, required: false, desc: COMMENT}

r18.quote:
service: gl_query
title: GL POSTING QUERY
module: AP
kind: read
screen: AP-GL-14
since: "7.0"
endpoint: POST /ll72/svc/gl_query

r19.quote: auth: session token in header X-LL-Session; the user's role must allow the service

r21.quote: envelope: {rc: "S | W | E", err_cd: "error code when rc is E", msg: "short message in capitals", data: "result"}

r23.quote:
service: gl_reverse
title: GL POSTING REVERSE
module: AP
kind: write
screen: AP-GL-14
since: "7.0"
endpoint: POST /ll72/svc/gl_reverse

r24.quote: auth: session token in header X-LL-Session; the user's role must allow the service

r25.quote:
- {name: jv_no, type: str, required: true, desc: JV NO}
  - {name: reason, type: str, required: false, desc: REASON}

r26.quote: envelope: {rc: "S | W | E", err_cd: "error code when rc is E", msg: "short message in capitals", data: "result"}
